speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging and lung function tests strongly suggest emphysema, but the ankle swelling is unusual for uncomplicated COPD. Have you experienced any sudden weight gain, decreased urine output, or pain in your calves? REQUEST TEST: BNP (B-type Natriuretic Peptide) REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal BNP and echocardiogram make heart failure unlikely, so the ankle swelling is likely due to venous insufficiency or medication side effects. speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening symptoms with exposure strongly supports an occupational component to your COPD.
